description: Mongo Express, the web admin UI for MongoDB and FerretDB, behind generated basic auth. Hardened by QuenchWorks as a minimal, nonroot, 0-CVE image, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.

Hardened continuous profiling stack: Grafana Pyroscope (profile store and query) + Grafana with the Pyroscope datasource provisioned. Apps push CPU and memory profiles to <release>-pyroscope:4040 (Pyroscope SDKs or Grafana Alloy); explore them in Grafana via Explore -> Pyroscope. No operator, no CR…

trust-manager, cert-manager's trust bundle distributor: a Bundle gathers CA certificates from ConfigMaps, Secrets and inline PEM and writes them into every selected namespace. Hardened by QuenchWorks as a minimal, nonroot, 0-CVE image, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.
